title: Labcoat settings file
description: Settings for Labcoat (a web UI for Microsoft.Testing.Platform tests): .labcoat.json or .config/labcoat.json in a workspace, or the user file ~/.labcoat.json (also ~/.config/labcoat/config.json, %APPDATA%\Labcoat\config.json). See docs/configuration.md.

$schema.description: The schema of this file, for editor completion.

ui.description: Defaults for the UI's settings (the Settings page). A choice made in the browser wins over a default, unless the setting is listed in "locked".

mode.description: Light or dark, or follow the operating system. Built-in default: system.

motion.description: Animations: follow the operating system's reduce-motion setting, short fades only, or none. Built-in default: system.

editor.description: The editor every "open in editor" action launches. Built-in default: vscode.

coverageTint.description: How the coverage source view marks lines: a tint across the full line, or a bar in the gutter. Built-in default: line.

confetti.description: A confetti burst when a run turns the suite green. Built-in default: false.

partialRunsInHistory.description: List runs of a single test, a class or a few tests in the run switcher and the per-test history. Built-in default: false.

openOutputOnError.description: Open the output panel when a build or run logs an error. Built-in default: false.

singleKeyShortcuts.description: Single-key shortcuts (W, ?, R / C / O in the tree). Built-in default: true.

locked.description: Settings the browser can't change: they are shown disabled and always use the value set here (or the built-in default). "all" or true locks every setting.

coverage.description: Code coverage: true starts with collection on (like --coverage); an object also chooses the settings and filters (docs/features.md "Code coverage").

enabled.description: Start with code coverage collection on (like --coverage).

settings.description: Coverage settings file (a Microsoft.CodeCoverage configuration or a .runsettings with a CodeCoverage section) for every test project, like --coverage-settings. Relative: to each test project, then to this file's directory. Default: the project's own coverage.settings.xml / CodeCoverage.xml / *.coverage.xml / *.runsettings, else Labcoat's defaults.

include.description: Module names or path globs to count although Labcoat's defaults leave them out, e.g. "Labcoat.*" (like --coverage-include). A glob without / matches a module or file name; with /, a source path.

exclude.description: Module names or path globs never to count, e.g. "MyApp.Tools" or "**/Migrations/**" (like --coverage-exclude). Applies with a settings file too.

traces.description: Start with per-test trace collection on (like --traces; only has an effect under an Aspire AppHost).

traceFilter.description: While per-test trace collection is on, trace only the tests that match this filter (like --trace-filter), in the UI's search syntax: cat:<category>, trait:<key>[=<value>], proj:<project> or name text; every term must match, case-insensitive. is: and msg: are not allowed (they depend on the result). An invalid filter stops Labcoat with an error.

affectedBase.description: Base git ref of 'Run affected: branch vs …', e.g. "origin/develop" (like --affected-base). Default: origin/HEAD, else origin/main, origin/master, main or master.

impactMap.description: Granularity of the test impact map used by watch mode and 'Run affected' (like --impact-map): class = one coverage run per test class (fast; every test of a class shares its data), test = one coverage run per test (exact, slower), auto = per class, then the classes a change maps to are refined per test in the background. Default: auto.

maxParallelProjects.description: Test projects discovered and run at the same time (like --max-parallel). Builds are one dotnet build for all projects either way. Default: the number of processors, at most 4.

hangThreshold.description: A running test is shown as possibly hanging after this long (like --hang-threshold): seconds, or a duration such as "90s", "2m". 0 or "off" turns it off. Default: 60 seconds.

testTimeout.description: Per-test timeout (like --test-timeout): a test running longer is marked timed out and its project's run is cancelled. Seconds, or a duration such as "30s", "5m". 0 or "off" = no timeout (the default). Not MTP's --timeout, which limits a whole test session.

port.description: HTTP port (used as an explicit port). --port, PORT and ASPNETCORE_URLS win over it.
